description: This file defines the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It includes class declarations, nested classes, interfaces, and method signatures related to message control, WebSocket communication, plugin management, and remote connection notifications. The file sets up the structure for a plugin that handles messaging, configuration, and remote connection events in a modular framework.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Main class implementing message control functionalities, plugin interfaces, and remote connection notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A nested thread class used to dispatch messages asynchronously.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for message control settings, including network node details.

classes.name: NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents a network node with port and binding information.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications and manages observing remote connections.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel to the message control.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel from the message control.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements or messages.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Dispatches a message to all interested parties.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the message callback handler.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables message types for specific categories and modules.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Provides an iterator over message control settings.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Fetches and processes messages from the message client.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of temporary or obsolete message files.
